name: Post Oak Sovereign Beef Short Rib
source: inspired by Franklin Barbecue (Austin, Texas) and Frantzén (Stockholm, Sweden)
description: An elevated Texas barbecue masterpiece featuring post oak smoked beef short rib with black pepper bark, burnt onion molasses glaze, smoked tallow potato silk, ember-charred sweet peppers, and black pepper beef jus.
keywords: texas bbq, smoked short rib, beef rib, post oak, michelin barbecue, smoked beef, fine dining bbq

winePairings.name: Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
winePairings.notes: Powerful tannins and dark fruit stand up to the richness of smoked beef.

winePairings.name: Texas Tempranillo
winePairings.notes: Earthy spice and smoke-friendly structure complement the pepper bark and oak smoke.

steps.instruction: Trim excess exterior fat from the short rib while keeping the fat cap intact.
Mix kosher salt, black pepper, smoked beef powder, and espresso powder to create the rub.
Season the short rib aggressively on all sides and refrigerate uncovered overnight.
Preheat offset smoker to 250°F using post oak wood splits.
Place short rib bone-side down in smoker and maintain clean blue smoke throughout cooking.
Spritz lightly with warm beef stock every 90 minutes and brush dry areas with melted beef tallow.
Smoke until bark is dark and internal temperature reaches approximately 175°F.
Wrap tightly in unwaxed butcher paper and continue smoking until probe tender at 203°F.
Rest in a warming cabinet or warm oven for 2 hours before slicing.
Prepare smoked tallow potato silk and burnt onion molasses while beef rests.
Char sweet peppers directly over binchotan charcoal until blistered and lightly collapsed.
Warm black pepper beef jus and lightly smoke using a smoking gun just before serving.
Plate smoked potato silk first, place sliced beef rib on top, and garnish with peppers, burnt onion molasses, pickled mustard seeds, and beef jus.
Char onions cut-side down over live fire until nearly blackened.
Cook onions slowly in beef fat until completely softened.
Add bourbon, molasses, vinegar, and smoked salt.
Reduce until glossy and thick, then blend smooth and strain.
Smoke potatoes indirectly until fully tender.
Pass potato flesh through a fine sieve.
Warm cream, butter, and smoked tallow together.
Fold warm dairy mixture into potatoes until silky smooth.
Season with salt and hold warm until service.
Reduce beef stock with shallot and peppercorns by half.
Strain through a fine chinois.
Whisk in cold butter before serving.
Cold smoke briefly with smoking gun before plating.
Simmer mustard seeds in fresh water three separate times, draining between each simmer.
Combine vinegar, water, sugar, and salt in saucepan.
Cook mustard seeds in pickling liquid until tender and glossy.
Cool completely before serving.
